Housing priorities have changed since the regulation was established in 2012 and last reviewed in 2017. It was originally created to ensure safety and habitability, and primarily focused on low-rise rentals. With increased growth and an evolving housing landscape, updates to rental regulations will benefit landlords and tenants. This review is a proactive approach to addressing housing needs, affordability concerns, safety and the changing dynamics of the rental market - all while balancing the needs of tenants and property owners.
